name: Fish Flight Entertainment
description: Design tokens for the Fish Flight Entertainment brand: colors, typography, and logo asset references.

color.name: ff-teal
color.label: Fish Flight Teal
color.usage: Primary brand accent. Used for the 'ENTERTAINMENT' wordmark, the FF monogram, links, and small accent details. Pair with black or white, not with each other's near-tones.

color.name: ff-black
color.label: Fish Flight Black
color.usage: Primary background and primary text-on-light color. The default brand surface — most logo lockups are built to sit on black.

color.name: ff-white
color.label: Fish Flight White
color.usage: Primary text-on-dark color and secondary background. Used for the 'FISH FLIGHT' headline wordmark on dark lockups.

headline.usage: Bold, condensed block letterforms echoing 'FISH FLIGHT' in the primary wordmark. Headlines and hero statements only.

subhead.usage: Lighter, letter-spaced companion to the headline face, echoing 'ENTERTAINMENT' under the wordmark. Section labels, nav, eyebrows.

logo.description: Full color stacked lockup (monogram + wordmark) on a light/white ground.
Full color stacked lockup with transparent background. Preferred for placing on brand-black surfaces.
Stacked lockup with black wordmark text and transparent background, for light surfaces.
Horizontal lockup (monogram beside wordmark) on black. Use where vertical space is limited, e.g. headers.
Tightly cropped stacked lockup on black.
FF monogram only, no wordmark, transparent background. Use for small/square placements (app icons, avatars, favicons).
FF monogram only, black & white, transparent background. Use for single-color/print-restricted contexts.
Full stacked lockup in black & white. Use where color reproduction isn't available.

voice.summary: Fish Flight Entertainment writes like industry veterans who chose passion over routine: confident, a little irreverent, proud of its Vancouver film-industry roots, and unafraid to describe ambitious bets in plain, vivid language ('jump off the cliff and build our wings on the way down').
voice.originStory: Named for the legendary 5am YVR-to-LAX 'Fish Flight' that once carried fresh seafood and, in the analog era of Hollywood North, film reels of VFX and animation footage for same-day studio feedback. Founded by Paul Furminger and Sabrina Furminger, Fish Flight Entertainment is a boutique studio with roots across TV, film, and gaming, now focused on gaming and interactive entertainment. It is the parent company of YVR Screen Scene, a digital magazine and podcast covering the Vancouver film and television industry.
